content: The physical body is the sacred foundation and instrument for the performance of all righteous duty.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Shariram adyam khalu dharma-sadhanam (शरीरमाद्यं खलु धर्मसाधनम्) — Kalidasa's Kumarasambhava
explanation: Spiritual enlightenment, artistic creation, civic duty, and loving family service all require a functional biological vessel. To abuse the body through chronic exhaustion, toxic consumption, or neglect is to smash the musical instrument upon which the soul must play.
practicalInsight: Treat your body as a sacred temple today: hydrate thoroughly, move your limbs, and prioritize restorative sleep.
reflectionPrompt: Are you treating your physical health as an afterthought, forgetting that it is the vehicle of all your noble aspirations?
